meta.title: News skill
meta.description: Adds a news skill for DSH. Ask for today's or a dated news briefing and it fetches four categories from public RSS and live feeds: international news, domestic economy, domestic tech, and global tech, five items each. Every item carries a title, source, timestamp, and the original link; nothing is invented when a source is unavailable. Use -Date yyyy-MM-dd for a past day.
